newsitem.title: USA: IVAX says completes sale of unit to B Braun.
newsitem.headline: IVAX says completes sale of unit to B Braun.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Wednesday said Wednesday it completed the previously announced sale of its McGaw Inc unit to B. Braun Melsungen AG for $320 million in cash at closing, subject to certain post closing adjustments.

Over a period of years, B. Braun will make additional payments, up to a total of $80 million, contingent upon the combined operating results of McGaw and B. Braun's principal U.S. operating subsidiary.
IVAX will also receive royalties and other payments based on McGaw's and B. Braun's commercialization of the Duplex drug delivery system.
Duplex, presently under development, is a drug delivery system designed for drugs with limited stability after mixing.

IVAX used a portion of the cash received at closing to pay off its existing credit facility, which is being terminated, and also recognized an about $2.1 million pre-tax charge relating to the early extinguishment of this debt.
